title: Niederer et al. 2011 N-version benchmark: activation time at P1-P9

sources.citation: Niederer SA, Kerfoot E, Benson AP, et al. Verification of cardiac tissue electrophysiology simulators using an N-version benchmark. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 369(1954):4331-4351 (2011)
sources.note: open-access full text (PMC3263775, mirrored by Europe PMC) and Figure 1 (rsta20110139-g1.jpg)

sources.citation: Electronic supplementary material of the same article: the per-code activation times at P1-P9
sources.note: behind a bot check on 2026-09-26; not retrieved. Figure 1's caption says it holds the activation times at P1-P9, not a coordinate table. P2, P3, P6 and P7 are placed by this file's own choice of naming order, which has not been checked against this ESM

quantity.name: activation time
quantity.definition: the time at which the membrane potential first passes through 0 mV

source.where: section 3f (metric); milliseconds throughout, section 3d and Figures 2-4

frame.definition: A convention adopted by this file; the paper prints no coordinates. Origin at P1, the stimulus corner. Axis 1 runs along the 20 mm edge (the fibre direction), axis 2 along the 7 mm edge, axis 3 along the 3 mm edge, each pointing into the slab. The slab's dimensions (20 x 7 x 3 mm), its fibre axis and the stimulus corner are the paper's.

source.where: section 3b and Table 3 (dimensions, fibres along the 20 mm axis); section 3c (stimulus at one corner); Figure 1b (P1 at that corner)

points.label: P1
points.definition: the corner where the stimulus is delivered; the P1-P8 line starts here

points.label: P2
points.definition: the corner adjacent to P1, displaced along the 7 mm edge (P1's bottom, 3 mm-axis, face); the P2-P6 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: Figure 1b (the P2-P6 vertical line); which neighbour of P1 is P2 (7 mm edge or 20 mm edge) is this file's choice, not checked against niederer2011's ESM

points.label: P3
points.definition: the corner adjacent to P1, displaced along the 20 mm (fibre) edge (P1's bottom, 3 mm-axis, face); the P3-P7 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: Figure 1b (the P3-P7 vertical line); which neighbour of P1 is P3 (20 mm edge or 7 mm edge) is this file's choice, not checked against niederer2011's ESM

points.label: P4
points.definition: the corner of P1's 3 mm-axis face diagonally opposite P1; P8 lies directly above it along the 3 mm edge

points.label: P5
points.definition: the corner above P1 along the 3 mm edge; the P1-P5 vertical line pairs with it

points.label: P6
points.definition: the corner above P2 along the 3 mm edge; the P2-P6 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: Figure 1b (the P2-P6 vertical line); follows P2, whose naming order is this file's choice

points.label: P7
points.definition: the corner above P3 along the 3 mm edge; the P3-P7 vertical line pairs with it

source.where: Figure 1b (the P3-P7 vertical line); follows P3, whose naming order is this file's choice

points.label: P8
points.definition: the corner diagonally opposite P1 through the slab; the P1-P8 line ends here, and it activates last

source.where: Figure 1 caption; section 5; section 5b (the far corner); section 6

published_values.label: P8
published_values.kind: range of last activation across the participating codes
published_values.conditions: the highest spatial and temporal resolutions (dx 0.1 mm, dt 0.005 ms)

source.where: section 6 (Discussion): 'the time of last activation ... still differs across the codes between 37.8 and 48.7 ms'; resolutions from section 3d. Corrected 2026-09-26 (controller review M8): attached to point P8 by inference, not by an explicit P8 label in that sentence -- P8 is identified as the last-activating point (the far corner) by Figure 1's caption and section 5b
